name: DES Y3

bins._provenance: cluster-lensing-cov/configs/des_y3.json, which carries the same edges as Y1
bins._note: No distinct Y3 binning is recorded in any source this package tracks. These are Y1's. Replace them here when a real Y3 definition exists -- that is the point of this being a config.
bins._note_sigma_z: sigma_z is the photo-z scatter, 0.01. The 0.03 that appears as SIGMA_Z in the y3 production config is the 3-sigma window, not the scatter -- do not use it as sigma_z. One value per richness bin, because the papers allow richness dependence.

sources._note_pz_is_a_placeholder: sigma_gamma and n_src_arcmin are DES Y3 metacalibration, but the p(z_s) SHAPE is still the Y1 fit -- that config says so itself: 'DES Y1 source-distribution shape retained as a placeholder; replace with the DES Y3 source n(z)'. Switch pz_model to 'tabulated' and add z/dndz arrays when you have the real one.

_note_omega_z: The des_y3 fit is FLAT at the 4143 deg^2 gold footprint -- the area of the data -- because no z-dependent Y3 fit exists. cluster-lensing-cov/configs/des_y3.json carries 5000 deg^2 instead, but that file is a forecast (its counts are 'DES Y1 counts scaled by 5000/1437'), so the two numbers describe different things and must not be reconciled.
